{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Richard Beez''' (27 May 1827 &ndash; 28 March 1902) was a [[German people|German]] [[mathematician]] who proved [[Beez's theorem]].

He studied at the [[University of Leipzig]], where in 1850 he obtained a [[Ph.D.]] Later, Beez was a Gymnasium teacher in [[Plauen]].<ref>{{Citation
